label: early <DEL> / m / t input in short sequences starting with d,b,h,3,f,y
explanation: Fires almost only before the copy phase: about 58% of activation mass is on the <DEL> step (about 5.6% of DEL steps fire) and most of the rest is on original-phase inputs m and t (with w and i weaker), nearly always on the first occurrence of the token. Concentrated at steps t=3..6, so it favors short sequences (L=3..5 have the highest rates). Rate and magnitude go up when the first original token is d, b, h, 3, f or y (d is strongest; the top activations are DEL steps in sequences starting with d). It essentially never fires during the copy phase (0.7% of mass) or at t=0. Precision is limited: most early DEL/m/t steps with these first tokens still do not fire, so a hidden-state factor this predicate does not capture also gates it.
